tuples.subject: prepayment_charge
tuples.quote: There shall be no pre-payment charge levied on microfinance loans.

tuples.subject: penal_charges
tuples.quote: Charges, if any, for delayed payment shall be applied on the overdue amount and not on the entire loan amount.

tuples.subject: other
tuples.special_circumstance: Change in interest rate or any other charge
tuples.quote: Any change in interest rate or any other charge shall be informed to the borrower well in advance and these changes shall be effective only prospectively.
